claim_updates.reason: Frozen decision_rule condition C4 fails (null control mean 0.552 > 3*std 0.044), triggering MEASUREMENT_INVALID. No confirmatory claim update permitted. However, the descriptive finding is scientifically significant and reproducible: state-history K=2 conditional PMI = 0.933 bits (18.6x threshold, p=0.001, d=25.9), demonstrating beyond-Markov URL-level PMI on the 12-state hash-routed SPA simulation at N=5000. The parent sparsity bottleneck (N=1000, 1.4% strata used) is resolved (30.8% strata used at N=5000). Action-history K=3 also detects at N=5000 (1.221 bits, p=0.001), contradicting the hypothesis that state-history conditioning is necessary. The null control failure is an inherited design limitation (trajectory-level block permutation cannot center null at 0 for hash-routed SPA, per parent audit V2), not measurement error. Status remains HYPOTHESIS because MEASUREMENT_INVALID provides no confirmatory basis for advancement.
